_doc: Facts the bot may cite in drafts. Only claims that are true AND checkable in the public repo. Add to it; never inflate it.
headline: Builds self-custody agent tooling that checks its own books against the chain
facts: Event-sourced, hash-chained double-entry ledger that rebuilds a wallet's full history from raw RPC and reconciles to the chain to the wei every 15 minutes
Isolated transaction signer: allowlisted contracts and selectors, recipient rules decoded from calldata, exact capped approvals, single-use signed receipts, kill switch
Every transaction is simulated on a mainnet fork first and must pass a rule gate; 18 adversarial canaries run daily against the real gate
Independent auditor (separate code, own RPC path) that can halt the system but never approve or sign
Research lab: 790 strategies backtested with walk-forward ML, perp funding and liquidation modelling, deflated Sharpe and a bootstrap reality check; zero survived, and the lab says so
Pre-registered forward test (docs/12-forward-test-plan.md) with a fingerprinted plan, 15 paper accounts, and automatic day-30 review
74 offline tests plus fork integration tests that execute real contract flows against a mainnet fork
Found and corrected its own mistakes in public docs (a wrong gas figure, a block-time unit error, a wrong router address recalled from memory)
